# ex: substitution involving cross-package identifier
ex {
	import "fmt"
	var x int
	fmt.Println(x) -> fmt.Printf("%d\n", x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

import "fmt"

func F() {
	fmt.Println(1)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 import "fmt"

 func F() {
-	fmt.Println(1)
+	fmt.Printf("%d\n", 1)
 }
